lead_raw_text:
The La2Cu2O4 structure (reduced formula LaCuO2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cu centers in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors at 1.8466 Å, while La centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve O neighbors at 2.6612–2.6734 Å. The CuO6 octahedra and La-centered 12-vertex polyhedra display corner- and edge-sharing, respectively, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites.
